1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the cell is a eukaryotic cell__.

2. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme.

4. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

5. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

7. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides __from a single bacterial species__.

9. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from __a single BMC operon__.

11. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag.

12. (Currently Amended) A method __for producing a bioactive compound__ comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium __that does not naturally contain the at least one BMC polypeptide__.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli __that does not naturally contain the at least one BMC polypeptide__.

16. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Previously presented) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga.

21. (Currently Amended) A method __for producing a bioactive compound__ comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product __other than propionate__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor __other than propionate__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production __other than propionate__.

25. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate __other than propanediol__.

26. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments __using a method other than differential centrifugation__.

27. (Previously presented) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments __wherein each compartment comprises a different enzyme__.
